Check the cross-area overlapping-report example, not only fitting-row family membership.

limitations: This is a standalone full-task close-audit at the supplied completion SHA; no controller-close relaxation was inferred. The task remains active and this report does not close it or declare controller acceptance.
The production training was not rerun. Ignored run artifacts were read and hashed, then copied to scratch for replay. The clone shares no Git metadata or hardlinks with the source repository.

Original upstream climate generation/provenance limitations and oracle-weather/ideal-label-availability assumptions remain as explicitly inherited in the task; upstream preprocessing was not regenerated. Monthly feature parity is supported by committed parity evidence and source inspection, with independent raw-label and seasonal-value checks.
The synthetic smoke replaces monthly scope recovery/parity and reduces tree settings for synthetic inputs; real-source checks and the production saved-model replay provide separate evidence.
The GitNexus IPCCH index was 13 commits behind HEAD; no reindex was performed. Findings and citations use the pinned Git blobs rather than the stale graph.

The missing-P5 and transitive-history defects are demonstrated on valid synthetic inputs. Current raw data has no missing-P5 history-only candidates and all 331 production pool histories pass the independent exclusion check; no current result contamination is asserted.

Read-only scouts were used for independent code/data inspection under the user standing delegation instructions; the primary auditor reproduced the reported defects and performed final validation. No executor transcript was used as evidence.

The reference-history portability test is skipped because its separate reference checkout is absent in the isolated clone (tests/unit/test_somalia_oracle.py:187). The first combined focused-test invocation was intentionally stopped during the slow smoke phase after excessive native threading; the complete command was rerun with OMP/BLAS threads capped at one, retaining the frozen package versions and model settings.
